original_purpose: Supply a faithful, auditable source-to-evidence packet for a specified descriptive research question
binding_restriction: Directly treating the reported marginal as authoritative leaves a contradiction with subgroup means and a conflicting supplementary population
removable_part: One unsupported point estimate need not be required for the separate accepted audit and conditional-reconstruction purposes
replacement: Preserve all-source HOLD and name alternative source hypotheses; derive tight rounding envelopes within each, with zero silent repair
realization: run_development.py + original publisher XML/PDF/TableS4 + exact rational independent review
falsifier: Any admitted unconditional correction, an unreported dropped source constraint, a wrong source meaning, or an independently disproved bound
retained_original_requirement: The original exact corrected-point request remains HOLD; no easier evaluator makes it pass

original_purpose: Reconstruct unfamiliar source evidence with valid semantics and uncertainty
binding_restriction: A previous source mapping does not establish the fresh report design, units, population, or covariance
replacement: Reuse exact generic executable bytes while the recipient independently requalifies its mission and output
realization: fresh U/E/E+ sessions and actual recovered capsule; current source contract
falsifier: Recipient merely cites the artifact without executing it, or its outputs/effort do not improve over E
expected_result: Actual execution can support transferable construction even if incremental quality and cost advantage remain unestablished

original_purpose: Finance accepted evidence-service work and retain only economically justified capabilities
binding_restriction: Optional construction and retention cost cash before uncertain future collection
replacement: Predeclared price/participation rule, locked deposits, complete A/B/C costs, prospective retention bound and earned-surplus cash checks
realization: existing Ledger + run_economics.py + native modeled accounting
falsifier: Any zero/negative gain, support/default/withdrawal or delayed payment removes incremental advantage or funding
evidence: Conditional assumed markets; no actual customer or live authority
